newsitem.title: UK: General Accident gains on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: General Accident gains on short-covering.

text.p: Shares in General Accident Plc were marked higher on Monday as the market strove to cover short positions, dealers said.
General Accident shares were up nine pence, or 1.07 percent, to 847p by 0915 GMT in volume of 385,000 while the FTSE-100 index was 3.6 points, or 0.08 percent, higher at 4,373.3.

General Accident said last Wednesday that favourable winter weather conditions in Britain and North America would see it posting "much improved" first quarter results compared with the year-ago period.

General Accident is due to announce first quarter figures on May 13. Its pre-tax operating profit dipped to 55 million stg from 112 million stg in the first quarter in 1996 after weather-damage claims cost it 70 million stg.
The insurance sector 0#.FTIC was otherwise quiet.
